content.title: Syracuse women’s basketball beats Iowa State, advances to NCAA second-round matchup with No. 1 seed UConn
content.text: Syracuse, N.Y. — The Syracuse women’s basketball team faces the Iowa State Cyclones in the first round of the NCAA Tournament at 5:30 p.m., Saturday at Gampel Pavilion in Storrs, Connecticut.The game will air on ESPN2.Note: Refresh this page throughout Syracuse’s game vs. Iowa State to see the latest updatesFINAL: Syracuse 72, Iowa State 63The Orange overcome a 37-point performance from Audi Crooks of Iowa State as Uche Izoje drops in 23 points with 7 rebounds for Syracuse. Laila Phelia adds 18 points for SU, stepping up big in stretches of the game where Izoje was on the bench in foul trouble. Olivia Schmitt gave SU a big lift off the bench with five 3-pointers. She had a total of 10 3’s all season coming into this matchup. Sophie Burrows did not score for the first 29 minutes of the game but came alive in the fourth quarter with 12 points, including four free throws down the stretch to ice the game. Syracuse advances to the second-round of the NCAA Tournament on Monday night where it will meet No. 1 seed UConn on its home floor in Storrs, Connecticut. FOURTH QUARTER:37 remaining: Syracuse 68, Iowa State 63It got dicey there for a stretch for SU but Iowa State missed a few shots and SU finally grabs a rebound and calls timeout with 37 seconds remaining and will try to hold on here down the home stretch. 1:20 remaining: Syracuse 68, Iowa State 63Audi Crooks cannot be stopped inside. She has 37 points and Iowa State takes a timeout. A 6-0 spurt there for Iowa State. 3:02 remaining: Syracuse 66, Iowa State 56Burrows hits another clutch 3-pointer to give SU a 10-point lead into a timeout. 4:06 remaining: Syracuse 63, Iowa State 54Sophie Burrows, who was 0-5 from 3-point range and 1-12 from the floor overall, buries a 3 to give SU a 9-point lead. The Orange has missed its prior eight shots before Burrows’ bucket. 4:50 remaining: Syracuse 60, Iowa State 54A 12-4 run for the Cyclones with Izoje out of the game and Iowa State trails by just six. Audi Crooks has 32 points for Iowa State. 7:13 remaining: Syracuse 58, Iowa State 47Uche Izoje has four fouls now, so Coach Jack will have to run a smaller line-up out there of Schmitt-Phelia-Thompson-Burrows-Potts for a good stretch of time. THIRD QUARTEREnd of the third quarter: Syracuse 54, Iowa State 42SU catches a break with a very shaky flagrant foul called on Iowa State. Sophie Burrows finally gets on the board with 2 free throws. Iowa State got the best of SU that quarter 16-13 but the Orange still lead by 12. 2:53 remaining: Syracuse 52, Iowa State 37Laila Phelia has stepped up with Izoje on the bench. She has 16 points overall now with 8 this quarter. 4:59 remaining: Syracuse 48, Iowa State 33It’s going to get interesting now to see the strategy from both squads as both team’s star players, Uche Izoje (19 pts) and Audi Crooks (17 points), have 3 fouls.6:59 remaining: Syracuse 46, Iowa State 30Crooks remains the only source of offense for Iowa State with 17 points and now she has 3 fouls. Izoje is up to 19 points on the evening but also has 3 fouls. HALFTIME: Syracuse 41, Iowa State 26SU wins the second quarter 30-12 over the Cyclones to take command of the game. Olivia Schmitt, who had 10 3-pointers all season, has 5 3’s off the bench for SU in this game. A huge boost for the Orange at the guard position with Dominique Darius out with an injured hand. Uche Izoje leads SU with 16 points. She has been aggressive in shooting the jumper from the free throw line. SU shot 49% in the first half, including 7-16 from distance. Iowa State is 1-11 from 3-point range. Cyclones star Audi Crooks has 15 points. SECOND QUARTER2:04 remaining: Syracuse 37, Iowa State 24Schmitt is on fire from distance, hitting 5 of 6 3’s in this game so far. SU with a 26-12 edge in the second quarter so far. 5:13 remaining: Syracuse 28, Iowa State 20A 10-0 run for the Orange to take the eight-point lead. Uche Izoje has not been shy firing up jumpers from from the free throw line area. She has 12 points. Olivia Schmitt is 3-3 from the 3-point line off the bench for SU. Audi Crooks is on the bench with two fouls. FIRST QUARTEREnd of first quarter: Iowa State 14, Syracuse 11Neither team found an offensive groove in the opening quarter. SU shot 5-17 (29%) while Iowa State was 6-19 (32%).Audi Crooks, the 2nd-leading scorer in the country with an average of 25.5 ppg, had 5 in the opening quarter. Coach Jack went to the bench to use Oyindamola Akinbolawa, who has a little more size than Uche Izoje, to defend Crooks.3:57 remaining: Syracuse 9, Iowa State 8Uche Izoje has 6 of SU’s early points. Iowa State has come out shooting 4-14. PregameSyracuse returns to the NCAA Tournament for the second time in four years under coach Felisha Legette-Jack.The Orange enters Saturday’s game short-handed after lead guard Dominique Darius was ruled out for the remainder of the season with an injury to her left hand.Iowa State is a 7.5-point favorite, as of Saturday morning.Much of the focus will center on the interior matchup between Audi Crooks and Uche Izoje. Crooks averages 25.5 points per game and 7.8 rebounds per game for the Cyclones, while Izoje, the ACC’s top rookie, has been a revelation for the Orange.The Orange average 16.8 offensive rebounds per game — seventh in the country and first in the ACC.Texas-transfer guard Laila Phelia provides a tournament-tested veteran from her time at Michigan.Syracuse women’s lacrosse, back in the Top 5, surges past Cornell for 10th straight winSyracuse freshman women’s basketball player plans to enter name in transfer portalSyracuse women’s lacrosse rides 9-game winning streak into Top 3 of latest pollSU women’s lacrosse runs up highest goal total of season in win over Pittsburgh
